items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: I worked with Duke Ellington in the '70s also.

ctx.x: I was going to Masbaum (PHONETIC) Music School after I left Overbrook. This is when I took up the cello. And when Cab Calloway and Duke Ellington's band came into town, the only club -- they would come to the Club Harlem and we would play their hit songs. (Laughter). "Minnie the Moocher" for Cab and what was Duke's -- "Ring Them Bells", you know. We really didn't give a damn about them.
Did they sit in? Did anybody --
